title: Constraint-Driven Auto-Tuning of GEMM-like Operators for MT-3000 Many-core Processor
problem: Optimizing deep learning operators, particularly GEMM-like operations, for emerging heterogeneous many-core processors like MT-3000 is challenging due to large search spaces and hardware-specific constraints. Existing approaches (hand-crafted libraries or general auto-tuners) are either expensive to develop or deliver sub-optimal performance.
motivation: MT-3000 and similar emerging many-core architectures require operator optimization but lack efficient optimization methods. The VLIW+SIMD architecture and hardware constraints make general-purpose tuning ineffective, while hand-crafting is expensive and error-prone.
method: The DynaChain framework optimizes GEMM-like matrix operations by separating two concerns: how to compute (arithmetic operations) and how to move data (from memory to processors), allowing each to be optimized independently. It uses constraint dependency chains—rules based on MT-3000's hardware capabilities—to automatically skip invalid scheduling options during the search, making it much faster to find good solutions. For matrix operations with irregular dimensions, it applies integer linear programming (mathematical optimization) to break down the problem efficiently. Finally, the actual computation kernels are custom-designed for MT-3000's VLIW+SIMD architecture (which executes multiple instructions at once and processes multiple data elements in parallel), with optimized register allocation and instruction pipelining for better throughput.
key_novelty: The innovation combines constraint dependency chains to automatically eliminate invalid search options, ILP-based decomposition for irregular matrix dimensions, and VLIW+SIMD-aware micro-kernel design with optimized register allocation and pipelining on MT-3000.
contributions: DynaChain operator-level optimization framework for MT-3000
Constraint dependency chains reducing search space dynamically
ILP-based decomposition for irregular matrix dimensions avoiding padding
Hardware-aware micro-kernel design for VLIW+SIMD architectures
Simplified kernel development matching expert-optimized library performance

metrics.search_efficiency: Constraint chains significantly reduce search space
